figurative_meaning_en: Pitch black or intensely dark color
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাতের আকাশ মিশমিশে কালো হয়ে উঠেছে।
তার চুল মিশমিশে কালো, যেন কালির মতো।
example_sentences_in_english: The night sky has turned pitch black.
Her hair is pitch black, like ink.
note: This idiom is often used in poetic and everyday descriptions of intense darkness in Bengali literature and speech.
